item.title: Daily Minute — October 31, 2026
item.description:
Therefore it corrects what never was. Further, the plan for this correction was established and completed simultaneously, for the Will of God is entirely apart from time. So is all reality, being of Him. The instant the idea of separation entered the mind of God’s Son, in that same instant was God’s Answer given. In time this happened very long ago. In reality it never happened at all.
The world

item.title: Lesson 125: “In quiet I receive God’s Word today.”
item.description: “In quiet I receive God’s Word today.” Let this day be a day of stillness and of quiet listening.Your Father wills you hear His Word today. He calls to you from deep within your mind where He abides. Hear Him today. No peace is possible until His Word is heard around the world; until your mind, in quiet listening, accepts the message which the world must hear to usher in the quiet time of peace.
